name: Zimri and Cozbi
charge: Bringing a Midianite woman into the camp in the sight of the congregation
summary: While the congregation wept at the tabernacle door over the plague, Zimri, a prince of Simeon, walked a Midianite princess past them into his tent. Phinehas followed with a javelin and thrust them both through.
offense: Open defiance of the judgment in progress: not hidden sin but sin paraded before Moses and the mourning assembly, by a leader, with the daughter of a chief of Midian. The offense was against the whole camp's standing before God.
judgment: Both died on the javelin, and the plague was stayed. God gave Phinehas a covenant of everlasting priesthood because he was zealous for his God and made an atonement. Sirach ranks him third in glory; the Maccabees claim him as father.
